description: Change of use from Class C3 (dwellinghouse) to Class C4 (HMO for up to 5 persons), and the erection of a single storey rear extension.
decision_conditions: The proposed development, by virtue of the number of potential occupants and proposed use, would represent an over-intensification of the site which would be harmful to the amenities of the neighbouring properties and at odds with the established character of the surrounding locality. The proposal would have an unacceptable and undue impact on existing residential amenity in terms of noise and disturbance, over and above what would be expected for a single family dwelling. As such, the proposal would therefore be contrary to Policy EM8 of the Hillingdon Local Plan - Part 1: Strategic Policies (2012), Policies DMH 5 and DMHB 11 of the Hillingdon Local Plan: Part 2 - Development Management Policies (2020) and Policy D14 of the London Plan (2021).

In the absence of any submitted details or evidence with regard to the level of present on-street parking demand within the locality and whether any spare capacity exists which could satisfactorily accommodate the potential parking displacement generated by the proposed level of occupancy, it is considered that the proposal has the potential to lead to undue on-street parking displacement to the detriment of parking capacity and safety on the local public highway. As such, the proposal would be contrary to Policies DMH 5, DMT 1, DMT 2 and DMT 6 of the Hillingdon Local Plan: Part Two - Development Management Policies (2020) and Policy T4 of the London Plan (2021).

The proposed development, in the absence of any submitted details and by virtue of its layout, fails to effectively demonstrate that sufficient and suitable provision for well-designed storage refuse space could be provided on-site, as well as suitable provision for secure and accessible cycle parking for the proposed occupiers, without harm to the visual character of the area.  As such, and in the absence of such provisions, the proposal would be contrary to Policies DMH 5, DMHB 11 and DMT 5 of the Hillingdon Local Plan: Part Two - Development Management Policies (2020) and Policy T5 of the London Plan (2021).
